remarks: Experience the charm of a bright and well-maintained second-floor unit in East Norwalk. This spacious living space features a cozy one-bedroom, an inviting eat-in kitchen, and a full bathroom, a mix of beautiful carpeting and hardwood flooring throughout. Convenience is at your fingertips with an in-unit washer and dryer, on-site parking, and an unbeatable location just minutes away from the East Norwalk train station, I-95, SONO, Veterans Park, and Calf Pasture Beach. Take a leisurely stroll to the water and immerse yourself in the vibrant coastal atmosphere. Enjoy the landlords covering water, while tenants are responsible for paying for gas, electricity, cable, and internet. Please note that pets and smoking are strictly prohibited. This property will be available as of Feb 1st, and we plan to sign for March 1st. AGENTS PLEASE CHECK PRIVATE REMARKS
